lesson.title: Cities, Streets & Buildings
lesson.subtitle: Cities, neighborhoods, parks, and indoor spaces
lesson.description: Talk about countries, cities, streets, neighborhoods, parks, and building features like elevators and stairs.

learning_objectives: Name geographic and urban places: 世界, 国家, 城市, 市, 外地, 小区, 街, 路边, and 公园.
Distinguish 地点 (event location) and 地方 (general place/area), plus 地 (ground).
Name building features: 电梯, 楼梯, 卫生间, 室, and 园.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Urban geography, public places, and building facilities.
overview.focus: Distinguish 地方 (any place/area) from 地点 (the specific venue/location of a meeting or event).

questions.prompt: How does the inside of the narrator’s neighborhood contrast with the streets outside?

dialogue.title: Showing a Visitor Around
dialogue.context_en: Xiao Chen shows an out-of-town friend around his residential neighborhood.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 欢迎来我们市玩儿！这是我住的小区。
turns.pinyin: Huānyíng lái wǒmen shì wánr! Zhè shì wǒ zhù de xiǎoqū.
turns.english: Welcome to our city! This is the neighborhood where I live.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 你们这儿真安静，路边还有个漂亮的公园。
turns.pinyin: Nǐmen zhèr zhēn ānjìng, lùbiān hái yǒu ge piàoliang de gōngyuán.
turns.english: It’s so quiet here, and there’s a pretty park by the roadside too.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 对，我们楼有电梯，不用爬楼梯。对了，你想去卫生间吗？
turns.pinyin: Duì, wǒmen lóu yǒu diàntī, búyòng pá lóutī. Duìle, nǐ xiǎng qù wèishēngjiān ma?
turns.english: Yes, our building has an elevator, so no need to climb stairs. By the way, do you need the restroom?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 好啊，一会儿咱们再去外面那条街转转。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo a, yíhuìr zánmen zài qù wàimiàn nà tiáo jiē zhuànzhuan.
turns.english: Sure, and later let’s stroll along that street outside.

patterns.title: Using 地方 vs. 地点
patterns.explanation_en: 地方 (dìfang) is any general place or region; 地点 (dìdiǎn) is the designated spot/venue for an event or meeting.
patterns.pattern_hanzi: 开会 / 集合 + 的 + 地点 + 是 + <Place>

examples.hanzi: 明天集合的地点在公园门口。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān jíhé de dìdiǎn zài gōngyuán ménkǒu.
examples.english: Tomorrow’s meeting location is at the park gate.

examples.hanzi: 我去了很多地方，最喜欢这个城市。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù le hěn duō dìfang, zuì xǐhuan zhège chéngshì.
examples.english: I’ve been to many places, and I like this city best.

patterns.title: Taking the elevator vs. climbing stairs
patterns.explanation_en: Use 坐电梯 (ride the elevator) and 爬楼梯 / 走楼梯 (climb/take the stairs).
patterns.pattern_hanzi: 坐电梯 / 走楼梯 + 上楼 / 下楼
patterns.pattern_pinyin: zuò diàntī / zǒu lóutī + shànglóu / xiàlóu
patterns.pattern_pseudo_translation: take elevator / walk stairs + go up / go down

examples.hanzi: 十层太高了，咱们坐电梯上去吧。
examples.pinyin: Shí céng tài gāo le, zánmen zuò diàntī shàngqù ba.
examples.english: The tenth floor is too high; let’s take the elevator up.

examples.hanzi: 二楼很近，我走楼梯就行。
examples.pinyin: Èr lóu hěn jìn, wǒ zǒu lóutī jiù xíng.
examples.english: The second floor is close; taking the stairs is fine for me.

guided_building.instruction_en: Talk about cities, countries, and public spaces.

model.hanzi: 世界各地的游客都喜欢来这座城市。
model.pinyin: Shìjiè gèdì de yóukè dōu xǐhuan lái zhè zuò chéngshì.
model.english: Tourists from all over the world like coming to this city.

substitutions.cue_en: Say his friend came from out of town.

model_answer.hanzi: 他的朋友是从外地来的。
model_answer.pinyin: Tā de péngyou shì cóng wàidì lái de.
model_answer.english: His friend came from out of town.

substitutions.cue_en: Say don’t sit on the ground because it is dirty.

model_answer.pinyin: Dì shàng hěn zāng, bié zuò zài dì shàng.
model_answer.english: The ground is dirty; don’t sit on the ground.

substitutions.cue_en: Say there are many small shops along the street.

model_answer.hanzi: 这条街的路边有很多小店。
model_answer.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē de lùbiān yǒu hěn duō xiǎo diàn.
model_answer.english: There are many small shops along the roadside of this street.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我住在一个很大的城市里，虽然街道上车来车往，但是我们小区里面环境很好，也很安静。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài yí ge hěn dà de chéngshì lǐ, suīrán jiēdào shàng chē lái chē wǎng, dànshì wǒmen xiǎoqū lǐmiàn huánjìng hěn hǎo, yě hěn ānjìng.
paragraphs.english: I live in a very big city; although the streets have heavy traffic, inside our residential neighborhood the environment is great and quiet.

paragraphs.hanzi: 小区北门外面就是一个公园，很多外地来的朋友都说这里是个适合生活的好地方。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xiǎoqū běimén wàimiàn jiùshì yí ge gōngyuán, hěn duō wàidì lái de péngyou dōu shuō zhèlǐ shì ge shìhé shēnghuó de hǎo dìfang.
paragraphs.english: Right outside the north gate of the neighborhood is a park, and many friends from out of town say this is a great place to live.

questions.prompt_en: What is right outside the north gate of the neighborhood?
What do friends from out of town say about this neighborhood?
questions.answer_en: That it is a good place to live.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Describe the neighborhood or city where you live.

model_answer.hanzi: 我住的小区附近有一条热闹的街和一个公园，生活很方便。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de xiǎoqū fùjìn yǒu yì tiáo rènào de jiē hé yí ge gōngyuán, shēnghuó hěn fāngbiàn.
model_answer.english: Near my neighborhood there is a lively street and a park, so daily life is convenient.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Ask where the restroom or elevator is in a building.

model_answer.hanzi: 请问，这里的电梯和卫生间在几层？
model_answer.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhèlǐ de diàntī hé wèishēngjiān zài jǐ céng?
model_answer.english: Excuse me, which floor are the elevator and restroom on here?

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: Use 条 for streets (一条街) and 座 for cities (一座城市). Also remember 卫生间 is the polite everyday word for restroom.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 城市 (chéngshì) moves from rising chéng to falling shì; 电梯 (diàntī) moves from falling diàn to flat tī.

Ask for elevators, stairs, and restrooms.
